alexcrichton opened PR #15123 from alexcrichton:less-personal-access-token to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit is an attempt to remove the need for a personal access token in CI as part of the release process. The original reason that this was added was due to the fact that CI needs to run and isn't triggered with the default token, but manual runs with the default token can be triggered and additionally not needing a personal access token at all seems best. This is an attempt, ahead of this week's branching of 51.0.0, to try to see if this works. If this does actually work I'd then backport this change to the other release branches.
